svg.title: Task 201 · Preliminary Hazard List worksheet
svg.desc: Spreadsheet view of Task 201 · Preliminary Hazard List, generated from safety/hazards/*.yaml.
svg.text: The analyst selects a severity (1–4, by the worst credible mishap) and a
probability (A–F, by likelihood over the item's life). MIL-STD-882E Table III
maps the pair to a risk level. Both selections and the stated basis are shown for
every hazard, so a reviewer can challenge the inputs, not just the result.

g.text: Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · 3D = three-dimensional · AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CONOPS = concept of operations · DoD = US Department of Defense · DQ-nnn = decision

question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · EC-nnn = edge case found by a failure search · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an

AI, to I3 independent organisation) · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · MOD-nnn = operating mode from the CONOPS (MOD-01 to MOD-10) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · RAC =

risk assessment code, severity category plus probability level (e.g. 1C) · ROLE-nnn = project role in the tailoring record (simulated until the lead says otherwise) · SF-nnn = walker failure-search family (sim/search) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-GSE = ground

support, maintenance supports, charging and test equipment · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance control · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN = manipulation arms and end effectors ·

SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage, distribution and thermal control · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK = chassis, legs, joint actuators and stability sensing ·
SUS-RISKDEF-001 = the project's tailored risk definitions (standards/tailoring) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
